expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The agent states: “Until March 2024 the limit was 10 minutes” and explains that members on slow mobile connections were logged out and lost their pantry orders, prompting the increase to 30 minutes. It warns that returning to 10 minutes would bring this problem back and asks, “How do you want to go ahead?”

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 5; first edit at step None
